paragraphs: A production-grade breakout analysis platform for NIFTY 500 / NIFTY 50 / F&O stocks. It goes beyond simple detection: every Donchian breakout is scored for quality, confirmed across timeframes, ranked against its sector, turned into a complete trade plan, and can be backtested, alerted on, paper-traded, or routed to Fyers as a real order.
Live app: breakoutscanner.streamlit.app — try it in your browser (no install).
features: Confidence scoring engine (scoring.py) — every breakout scored 0–100 from resistance age & touch count, candle anatomy, ATR expansion, relative volume, gap analysis, volatility contraction, EMA20/50 distance, closing…
Multi-timeframe confirmation — 1H / 1D / 1W / 1M trend alignment (EMA50/EMA200 + Supertrend); signals fighting the higher-timeframe trend are capped.

Chart-pattern recognition (patterns.py) — VCP, Cup & Handle, Flat Base, Ascending Triangle, Double Bottom, High Tight Flag, and Bull Flag/Pennant detected on the daily base with per-pattern confidence (📐 tags +…
Relative strength (relativestrength.py) — outperformance % and RS percentile vs NIFTY 50, plus outperformance vs the stock's own sector.
Sector rotation (sectors.py) — sectors ranked by equal-weight composite returns of the scanned constituents; leading-sector ★ badges, per-sector breakout counts, and sector filters.
